library: AI Visual QC taxonomy for Adobe Stock preflight
scope: Still image visual inspection. Similarity search intentionally excluded.
principle: Each finding must provide region/evidence, explanation, detection method, confidence/calibration status, and whether it is an Adobe requirement or an internal heuristic.

recommended_method: crop hands/feet at native resolution and 100% view
checks.evidence_required: Crop or bounding box plus concise description of the exact defect.
checks.decision: REVIEW by default; BLOCK only after the defect is clearly confirmed and materially harms quality.
checks.official_basis: Adobe explicitly asks contributors to check accurate anatomy and proportions for AI content.
caveats: Occlusion and perspective can make correct anatomy look odd.
Do not insist on visible five fingers when some are intentionally hidden.

look_for: facial parts merged with hair, glasses or clothing
recommended_method: VLM comparison of local geometry and context
checks.evidence_required: Face crop and observed mismatch; avoid generic claim 'bad face'.
checks.decision: REVIEW; judge according to intended style and whether an actual defect is visible.
checks.official_basis: Adobe asks for accurate anatomy, proportions and AI visual error checking.

look_for: eyes or joints that do not fit the species
implausible contact with ground or objects
checks.evidence_required: Crop and named anatomical or geometric issue.
checks.official_basis: Adobe's AI FAQ asks that humans and animals show no unintentional anatomical errors.
caveats: Stylized/fantasy animals are not judged by strict photo-real anatomy unless photorealism is intended.

look_for: perspective inconsistencies that look like defects
object parts changing material/shape without reason
recommended_method: compare object function and visible connections
checks.evidence_required: Object name, region and why geometry is inconsistent.
checks.decision: REVIEW; do not infer copyright/IP status solely from visual defect detection.
checks.official_basis: Internal visual QC heuristic based on Adobe's general accurate-detail and production-quality requirements.
caveats: Unusual design may be intentional; ask whether the asset is a fantasy concept or a realistic product.

recommended_method: VLM assess if text is intended and legible
checks.evidence_required: OCR region/crop; distinguish actual text from texture, scripts unfamiliar to OCR, or intentional abstract typography.
checks.decision: REVIEW. If branded/logo/IP phrase is detected, also run IP checks.
checks.official_basis: Adobe prohibits watermarks/branding and inaccurate or irrelevant metadata; gibberish-text detection is an internal visual heuristic, not a separately enumerated universal Adobe rule.
caveats: OCR failure is not proof of gibberish, especially for small, curved, decorative or non-Latin text.

look_for: main subject is soft/out of focus
recommended_method: measure sharpness over image and subject ROI separately
Laplacian variance or edge-energy only as a calibrated signal
checks.evidence_required: Subject ROI, sharpness metric, calibration profile and crop.
checks.decision: BLOCK only for confirmed unusable technical issue; otherwise REVIEW.
checks.official_basis: Adobe explicitly recommends inspecting at 100%; primary subject should be sharp and defined.
caveats: No universal Laplacian threshold. Smooth backgrounds, skin, fog and intentionally shallow depth of field naturally score differently.

look_for: shadow clipping obscuring key subject detail
recommended_method: vision review for intended high-key/low-key styles
checks.evidence_required: Highlight/shadow regions plus metric and visual explanation.
checks.decision: REVIEW; hard block only when required detail is clearly lost/unusable.
checks.official_basis: Adobe guidance covers balanced lighting and proper exposure, and warns against extremes leading to detail loss.
caveats: Intentional silhouette, night scenes, backlighting, and high/low key images are not defects by default.

recommended_method: inspect neutral regions only where they plausibly exist
checks.evidence_required: Affected region and observed condition; state whether measurement or model judgement produced the signal.
checks.official_basis: Adobe lists poor white balance/color correction, excess saturation, and color fringing as quality issues.
caveats: Do not assume all images contain neutral gray/white objects; creative color grading can be intentional.

checks.evidence_required: Crop, region type and objective measure if any.
checks.decision: REVIEW; don't auto-reject on noise scores alone.
checks.official_basis: Adobe warns against noise and artifacts from over-editing and high ISO; PNG guidance calls for clarity and no compression artifacts.
caveats: Film grain, intentional texture and rough illustration are not automatically defects.

look_for: plastic skin or loss of texture
checks.evidence_required: Crop with defect type and location.
checks.official_basis: Adobe warns about over-editing, oversharpening, masking errors and visible dust spots.
caveats: Skin retouching and stylized smooth surfaces may be intentional; require context.

look_for: reflections not corresponding to visible objects
recommended_method: VLM explain light direction and object support
checks.evidence_required: Explain the contradictory cues; avoid vague 'physics wrong'.
checks.decision: REVIEW; internal heuristic, not a standalone enumerated Adobe rule.
checks.official_basis: Internal heuristic for finding inaccurate visual details, grounded broadly in Adobe's visual quality expectations.
caveats: Stylized lighting, multiple light sources, mirror arrangements or surreal concepts can be intentional.

look_for: unnecessary excessive empty space for isolated PNG
subject not clearly separated for intended use
recommended_method: VLM assess intentionality and use case
checks.evidence_required: Preview with canvas bounds or subject mask.
checks.decision: REVIEW unless it violates explicit technical/use-case constraints.
checks.official_basis: Adobe quality guidance covers composition, excessive cropping, level horizons; PNG best practices recommend minimal excess space.
caveats: Negative space may be intentional and commercially useful in copy-space images.

look_for: opaque/matte background instead of alpha transparency
recommended_method: verify alpha channel and alpha bounds
checks.evidence_required: Alpha-channel stats plus previews on contrasting backgrounds.
checks.decision: BLOCK if no true transparency when transparency is required; REVIEW for halos or intended shadows.
checks.official_basis: Adobe requires transparent PNG backgrounds and clean isolation, recommends true transparency and minimal borders/space.
caveats: Do not discard purposeful translucent material, glass, smoke, or soft shadow assets solely because alpha is partial.

look_for: watermarks, timestamps, logos, branding, wordmarks and visible trademark text
wordmarks, logos, brand labels, packaging, uniforms/insignia, distinctive protected product design, artwork/murals, recognizable locations
checks.evidence_required: Box/crop + OCR text or object description + policy-source reference + focal-point context.
checks.decision: REVIEW by default; confirmed restriction/policy issue may BLOCK. Never automatically inpaint-and-pass.
checks.official_basis: Adobe lists watermarks, timestamps and branding as prohibited for photos/PNGs and identifies logos/brands/IP as common refusal reasons. Detection is screening, not legal clearance.
caveats: Known Restrictions is explicitly not all-inclusive. No match does not mean cleared; generic logo detection can create false positives.

look_for: title/keywords claim visible subjects not present
metadata includes prohibited IP terms for AI content
AI content mislabeled as 3D render or photograph without basis
recommended_method: vision caption grounded in visible objects
cross-check each key metadata claim against image
checks.evidence_required: Metadata term plus corresponding visual evidence or absence; mark uncertain claims.
checks.decision: REVIEW; correct unsupported metadata before submission.
checks.official_basis: Adobe requires accurate/relevant metadata and content-type choice consistent with visual characteristics.
caveats: Abstract/conceptual keywords can be valid when the concept is genuinely represented; don't enforce only literal object labels.

look_for: visible hateful symbols or text in context
potentially defamatory portrayal or caption relationship
content with sensitive subject matter requiring policy review
recommended_method: context review of full image and associated title/keywords
apply official policy rules, not model preference
checks.evidence_required: Specific visual/textual evidence and context; no unsupported inference from identity, nationality, religion or political symbols alone.
checks.decision: REVIEW by default; BLOCK only when the applicable policy violation is confirmed.
checks.official_basis: Adobe's common refusal reasons include hateful or defamatory content under non-compliance; this is context-sensitive and cannot be judged by keyword/image label alone.
caveats: Do not treat mere presence of political, religious, historical or controversial content as a violation; require contextual evidence and human review.
